result.rationale: In parseRefreshTokenResponse.ts, the schema uses `[z.string().toString()]: z.number()` as a computed key. Calling .toString() on a ZodString instance does not produce a wildcard pattern — it yields a literal string like "[object Object]" (ZodType does not override toString into a wildcard syntax). The resulting schema therefore requires a property literally named after that string plus `z.string().optional().toString()` key, which valid token responses won't have. When APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED and CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT are set, minimumTokenResponseSchema.safeParse will fail eve
